favourite.heading: Why Georgia State can pull away
bullets: Georgia State is the better football team by 8.4 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 64% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+8.4 pts).
Playing at Georgia State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Georgia State by 1.1 points: ball control vs front disruption (+1.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Northern Illinois can keep it close
bullets: Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 1.7 points to Northern Illinois (-1.7 pts).
The outcome range is 15.1 points wide at one sigma — p10 -11.1 to p90 +32.9 for Georgia State, so a projection of +11.9 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 3%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
